verification.precondition: A v2 session workspace contains one current resource version and one exact superseded version.
verification.stimulus: Validate the complete session, then retain a superseded version without history classification, duplicate its history reference, and remove the immutable version selected by history.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The complete immutable history and active head validate only when every retained superseded version is classified exactly once.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: the v2 session closes immutable resource history and active heads without deleting prior versions
verification.forbiddenMutation: No prior resource version may be unclassified, duplicated in history, deleted, or reinterpreted as the active head.

behavior: the v2 session closes immutable resource history and active heads without deleting prior versions
